TranscriptBefore she became one of the nation's top players, Lauren Betts was fighting a battle no one could see.AdvertisementAdvertisementAdvertisementGrowing up, she was often bullied because of her height, while also carrying the weight of high expectations.She signed with Stanford as the number one recruit in the country, but the pressure quickly became overwhelming.Even after transferring to UCLA, the struggles didn't just disappear.By 2024, she was battling depression and reached a breaking point, making the courageous decision to check into a psychiatric ward.It was the hardest and ultimately the best decision she ever made.Choosing to ask for help and committing to therapy changed everything.Now she's back in the Final Four for the second year in a row, alongside her sister Siena, living out their dreams together.CloseThe Lauren Betts comeback storyBreaking down the inspirational story of UCLA star Lauren Betts and her journey to the final four.0:40Now PlayingPausedAd
